title: John Wheeler's U diagram of the self-observing universe

tellings.quote: the the U with an where one tip of U is the big bang and the other tip is an eyeball staring back at the big bang

plain: The physicist John Wheeler drew the universe as a letter U: one tip is the Big Bang, and the other tip is an eyeball staring back at the Big Bang, the idea being that the universe gives rise to observers who in some sense look back on and help make its own beginning. The writer Eric Wargo describes the diagram to Michels in his own words, beside the ideas of the physicists Yakir Aharonov and John Cramer, as support for the view that effects can reach backward in time.
